raw_input: We are a heritage batik house. The batik itself is the product and must be shown as batik, not as an abstract print.
core_message: The batik is hand-drawn and the pattern is the point, so it should be shown as batik rather than reduced to a texture.

audience.description: Buyers aged 30 to 55 in Indonesian cities who collect hand-drawn batik and can tell tulis from cap.

deliverables: One 4:5 feed asset for the heritage batik line
mandatories: Show the batik pattern in full, hand-drawn detail
